description: Ministry of Sports - Appoint 3  member Interim Committee to the Sri Lanka Archery Association
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, specifically suspending the registration of a national sports association and appointing an interim committee. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action by a government minister exercising statutory powers, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters. While it mentions a minister's name, the primary content is regulatory action rather than personnel appointment or portfolio description.
